items.title: Getting Started

children.title: Onboarding
children.name: onboarding
children.prompt: Role-based guides (Contributor, Staff Engineer, Executive, Product Manager). Ground every architecture claim in the existing implementation wiki at docs/wiki/index.md rather than re-analyzing source from zero.

children.title: Contributor Guide — Zero to First PR in a Three.js Codebase
children.name: contributor-guide
children.prompt: Progressive guide for new contributors. Part I: TypeScript/Vite/Three.js foundations with cross-language comparisons to Python (classes vs prototypes, ES modules, requestAnimationFrame/setAnimationLoop vs Python loops). Part II: this codebase's architecture — bootstrap in [src/main.ts:30](https://github.com/noiz354/arena-city-try/blob/main/src/main.ts#L30), orchestrator [src/game/Game.ts:51](https://github.com/noiz354/arena-city-try/blob/main/src/game/Game.ts#L51), world builder [src/game/World.ts:37](https://github.com/noiz354/arena-city-try/blob/main/src/game/World.ts#L37), entities [src/entities/Player.ts:34](https://github.com/noiz354/arena-city-try/blob/main/src/entities/Player.ts#L34) / [src/entities/Vehicle.ts:29](https://github.com/noiz354/arena-city-try/blob/main/src/entities/Vehicle.ts#L29), 27 systems under src/systems/. Part III: dev setup, running/testing, codebase navigation. Appendices: glossary (40+ terms: chunk, LOD ring, hitscan, mulberry32, DPR, EffectComposer pass…) and key-file reference derived from docs/wiki/index.md tables.

children.title: Staff Engineer Guide — One Insight: Lazy Build-Once Chunks Behind a Fixed Update Order
children.name: staff-engineer-guide
children.prompt: Dense, opinionated brief. Core architectural insight: the city is a lazy build-once chunk cache ([docs/wiki/systems/ChunkManager.md](https://github.com/noiz354/arena-city-try/blob/main/docs/wiki/systems/ChunkManager.md)) driven by a strict per-frame update sequence owned by [src/game/Game.ts:51](https://github.com/noiz354/arena-city-try/blob/main/src/game/Game.ts#L51); include the insight as Python pseudocode. Provide Mermaid system-architecture diagram (Game → World → 27 systems wiring per [docs/wiki/game-loop.md](https://github.com/noiz354/arena-city-try/blob/main/docs/wiki/game-loop.md)), ER-style domain model of Player/Vehicle/Mission/Wanted state machines ([docs/wiki/entities.md](https://github.com/noiz354/arena-city-try/blob/main/docs/wiki/entities.md)), design tradeoffs (no physics engine, hand-rolled collision; seeded mulberry32 determinism), decision log incl. known doc-vs-code findings listed in [docs/wiki/index.md](https://github.com/noiz354/arena-city-try/blob/main/docs/wiki/index.md), dependency rationale, and a 'where to go deep' reading order across the 31 wiki files.

children.title: Executive Guide — Capability, Risk & Investment View
children.name: executive-guide
children.prompt: VP/director-level summary with NO code snippets. Capability map of the shipped game (open world, traffic, pedestrians, combat/wanted, missions, save/load, mobile controls, auto quality). Risk assessment grounded in known doc-vs-code findings of [docs/wiki/index.md](https://github.com/noiz354/arena-city-try/blob/main/docs/wiki/index.md) (e.g. traffic turn-RNG quirk, shared-material bug in WetSurfaceSystem) as proxies for technical debt. Technology investment thesis (Three.js browser stack, zero-backend persistence via [src/systems/SaveManager.ts:20](https://github.com/noiz354/arena-city-try/blob/main/src/systems/SaveManager.ts#L20)), cost/scaling model (client-only, device-bound via AutoQuality), dependency map (Vite/TypeScript/three), actionable recommendations.

children.title: Product Manager Guide — Player Journey Without the Jargon
children.name: product-manager-guide
children.prompt: Zero engineering jargon. User journey maps: spawn → walk/drive → wanted stars → police chase → mission completion (mission roster and zone radii from [docs/wiki/systems/MissionSystem.md](https://github.com/noiz354/arena-city-try/blob/main/docs/wiki/systems/MissionSystem.md)). Feature capability map (weapons, pickups, day/night, weather, minimap, mobile touch support per [docs/wiki/systems/MobileControls.md](https://github.com/noiz354/arena-city-try/blob/main/docs/wiki/systems/MobileControls.md)), known limitations (no HP regen caller, walk-speed mismatch — see Unresolved sections). Data/privacy overview: what telemetry collects via [src/analytics/tracker.ts:34](https://github.com/noiz354/arena-city-try/blob/main/src/analytics/tracker.ts#L34) and [src/analytics/gameTelemetry.ts:8](https://github.com/noiz354/arena-city-try/blob/main/src/analytics/gameTelemetry.ts#L8). Configuration/feature flags (postfx toggle, collider debug overlay). FAQ.
